primary_text:
At 8–12, joining a new group can feel like the hardest part. Youth BJJ gives complete beginners a clear way in: meet the coach, learn one movement, practice with a partner, and build from there.

On the first visit, your child can watch or participate while your family sees how the class feels.

Classes meet Tuesday and Thursday, 5:00–5:45 p.m. inside Castle Hill Fitness. Complete the class finder and Joao will personally call to help plan a free visit.
headline: A Place to Start and Learn Together

primary_text:
You or your child do not have to feel ready before starting.

In Youth BJJ at Castle Hill Fitness, ages 8–12 build confidence through coached practice, respectful partner work, and real progress.

For adults, private BJJ instruction at Castle Hill Fitness offers focused coaching, practical problem-solving, and progress at your own pace.

Complete beginners are welcome.

Find the right starting point in Austin.
